title: Active-loop read-only lane review artifact
description: Shared contract for a read-only agent-turn artifact produced by a Claude or Codex lane. The model fills verdict/summary/findings/next_steps; the agent-turn adapter authoritatively sets the remaining meta fields (schema_version, task_id, session_id, role, agent, generated_at, wu, privacy_scrubbed) after parsing and privacy-scrubbing. No raw private question/answer text, doc_id, chunk_id, filenames, prompt bodies, or absolute private paths (ADR 0005).

lane_model.description: ADR 0082: model ID actually used by the lane (e.g. claude-opus-4-7, gpt-5.5).

lane_effort.description: ADR 0082: resolved effort level for this lane (low/medium/high/xhigh/max). See lane_effort_applied for whether the runtime actually consumed it.

lane_effort_applied.description: ADR 0082: true if the lane's effort was actually passed to the underlying CLI (claude -p --effort), false when only persisted as evidence (codex companion 1.0.4 adversarial-review does not consume --effort). null when not applicable.

prior_artifact_ref.description: ADR 0082: agent name of the 1st lane this turn challenges (set on 2nd lane in adversarial mode).

lane_usage.description: ADR 0082: anthropic Messages API usage block (input_tokens/output_tokens/cache_*). Empty object when transport is codex companion or usage unavailable.
